newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia shares edge up, market seen flat.
newsitem.headline: Russia shares edge up, market seen flat.

text.p: Leading Russian shares rose slightly in light morning trading on Tuesday but traders said they did not expect any major changes in overall market levels.
"We're seeing a little recovery in blue chips," said Renaissance Capital trader Vladimir Chkikvadze.
The Russian Trading System 23-share index opened barely changed at 282.20 after Monday's closing 282.23, but ticked up to 283.05 at 0800 GMT.
But market bellwether UES EESR.RTS was up at $0.1915 at 0900 GMT after Monday's $0.1831 close and regional utility Mosenergo MSNG.RTS rose to $1.147 from $1.121.
Jittery world markets have diverted Western investors' attention of late, leaving the Russian market sluggish, but traders said the slight rally was on domestic buying orders.

"This is just morning demand and rouble deals. It's possible we'll see some Western orders later in the day after New York opens but we don't expect a big rise in the market," said Alexander Solovyov, a trader at Trinfiko.
Other traders said they did not see the rise lasting into the day.
"Prices were very low yesterday and some people may be short-covering this morning. I think the market will be flat today," Chkikvadze said.
